title: cymbidium cyperifolium var. aliciae
intro: Cymbidium cyperifolium var. aliciae, commonly known as the 'Aliciae Cymbidium', is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the Cymbidium genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbidium cyperifolium var. aliciae include acting as a nervine tonic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
